questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud computing

questions.question: Which statement best describes Cloud computing?

options.text: The cloud provider is responsible for the physical network infrastructure
An AZ-900 domain covering general cloud ideas and accounting for roughly 25–30% of the exam

questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Shared responsibility model refer to?

options.text: Cloud pricing in which charges generally track actual service consumption
Up-front spending on physical infrastructure such as servers, networking equipment, and datacenter space

Cloud infrastructure operated by a third-party provider and offered to multiple customers

questions.question: Which description correctly matches Public cloud?

questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of Private cloud?

options.text: A cloud environment dedicated to a single organization
Approaches that determine cloud costs based on factors such as consumption, service choices, and commitments
Ongoing spending for services consumed over time
Technology that helps manage Azure, on-premises, hybrid, and multicloud resources through a consistent management approach
